function: Learned MIMO precoding (deep-unfolded DU-BCA-MM precoder) for task-oriented multi-device edge inference over a MIMO uplink, trained with a feature encoder and MAP classifier (pp. 3, 11).
system: Uplink MIMO multiple access: K=1 device with 8 antennas (CIFAR-10) or K=3 devices with 4 antennas (ModelNet10), server 8 antennas; Rician fading; no RIS; band not stated (p. 11).
method: Deep-unfolded precoder (6-layer DU-BCA-MM, learnable matrices) with ResNet18/VGG11 feature encoder and MAP classifier; decoupled MCR2 pretraining, then E2E fine-tuning with cross-entropy, Adam (pp. 6-11).
data_channel: Simulated Rician channels (kappa 1, 80 m, path loss 32.6 + 36.7 lg d); CIFAR-10 and ModelNet10 task datasets; no standard or measured channel (p. 11).
test_conditions: Default kappa 1, noise -80 dBm; Table V trains on one Rician factor, tests on others (0.1 to 10); Fig. 9 tests SNRs unlike training (pp. 11, 14-15).
baselines: Non-learned: BCA and BCA-MM optimization precoders, LMMSE precoder and detector. Learned: black-box ResNet18 precoder, E2E learning without pretraining, vanilla DU-BCA, E2E feature encoder with LMMSE (pp. 12-14).
metrics: Classification accuracy (CIFAR-10, ModelNet10), MCR2 coding rate reduction value, CDF of accuracy over channel realizations, CPU execution latency, training time per epoch (pp. 12-15).
complexity: CPU execution time 0.008 s (DU-BCA) vs 0.046 s (BCA), 0.011 s (DU-BCA-MM) vs 0.053 s (BCA-MM) (Table IV, p. 13); parameters per layer (Table I, p. 11).
q1_support: p. 11: "modeled by Rician fading as"; custom Rician model with kappa = 1 and a simple path-loss formula; no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 15: "the network is trained on a specific Rician factor and tested across varying Rician factors"; Table V trains and tests at Rician factors from 0.1 to 10.
q3_support: p. 13: "We consider both the black-box network and optimization-based implementations of MCR2 precoding for comparison"; BCA and BCA-MM are non-learned, the ResNet18 black-box precoder is the learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 13: "Table IV presents the execution times of different precoding"; CPU time 0.008 s (DU-BCA) against 0.046 s (BCA); Table I (p. 11) gives learnable parameters per layer.
q5_support: p. 11: "We conduct the classification task on the CIFAR-10"; public task datasets only, the channel is simulated, and no code or data link is given.
notes: Area 3: the learned deep-unfolded precoder (DU-BCA-MM) is the MIMO precoding function, and the task-oriented coding passes because this precoder is learned. The precoders sit at the devices of an uplink MIMO multiple access channel but are computed at the server and fed back (p. 4: "calculating precoding matrices at the server and"), which the reviewer may weigh against the area 3 wording 'base station precoder'. q2 rests on Table V (p. 15); the SNR test of Fig. 9 (p. 14) would not count by itself. q3 rests on the black-box ResNet18 precoder as the standard learned architecture on the same problem; the BCA algorithm is the earlier non-learned design of the same authors [9]. The PDF is the arXiv preprint 2408.17397v1 with the title of the JSAC paper; the DOI is not printed in it.
